All 5 acts sit in the descriptive bands only and cannot reach the registered endpoint or the second count. Drop the 5 events disclosed, or retake the 5 readings (5 paid calls)?
ruling: Retake the 5 quarantined readings. The reviewer chose the retake in chat ("seems cheap to go for option 1", then "GO, write the note") and the paid calls wait for explicit approval of the GO note (relay 126).
effect: Each quarantined reading is re-taken once: the same frozen reader re-reads the same blinded case through a fresh single-reader collection built by the committed retake preparer from the shard's own corpus and catalog, launched by the frozen launcher under its own approval. At assembly, the original shard collection assembles with the quarantined batches omitted through a derived collection manifest (original untouched, omission disclosed), the retake collections assemble under full frozen verification, and the merge slots each retaken case into the quarantined case's place. The merge still requires each reader's case set to equal the 260 window cases exactly.
rule: One retake per quarantined reading (note 120). If a retaken reading is again assembly-invalid, there is no second retake: the pair falls to a disclosed drop ruling.
